stories.title: Distributed LLM Training Across Metros: Streaming DiLoCo in MaxText
stories.summary: Streaming DiLoCo in MaxText enables developers to efficiently train large language models across geographically distributed TPU slices by streaming parameter fragments instead of synchronizing full models at every step. This approach slashes cross-slice communication volume by over 60× and eliminates network stalls, allowing seamless multi-datacenter scaling without degrading model convergence or quality.

stories.title: Jeveration: System One Models Now Generate
stories.summary: System One models such as Jev return decisions through fast, parallel prediction. In this paper, we introduce Jeveration, showing that the same decision paradigm can also generate high-quality images in a single forward pass. Jeveration builds on a frozen vision-language model, repurposing its visual-semantic knowledge for holistic image generation. The key challenge is to maintain global consistency.

stories.title: The Resolution Hypothesis: Agent Evolution's Key Is Identifying Improvements
stories.summary: Agent evolution follows a simple loop: a proposer writes candidate artifacts (prompts, skills, memories) and selection accepts those that score higher. This loop has shown promise, yet practitioners face a puzzle: methods trade wins across papers, and evolution often fails to bootstrap on certain tasks.

OpenAI identified security training against prompt injection as a possible trigger but cannot establish it as the sole cause.
